main_text.p: אוֹ Syr. ܘ, ô particula exclamandi: Item Vah, illudendi, Mar.15.29.
אוּנָא Ch. & Syr. Diversorium, Hospitium, Mansio, Habitatio. Plur. אוּנִין.
אוֹנִיתָא Ch. Emptio, Contractus emptionis, Genef.49.21. in Targ.Hierof.& Jon. Convenit Græc. ὠνησις.
אוֹר Ch. Lux, Lumen. Hinc est verbaliter נְהוֹרָא Lucidi sint, vel fiant, Prov.4.25.
אוִיר Ch. Aer, Ἀήρ, emph. אוִירָא.
אוּרְקְסִין Ch. Idem quod אַרְכְּסִין Femoralia.
אוּרוֹכְלוּדוֹן Syr. Εὐροκλύδων Græc. Euro Aquilo, ventus, Act.27.14.
אוּשׁ אוּשָׁא Ch. Fundamentum, Pavimentum, Stratum, Solum: Paries. Plur. אוּשִׁין & אוּשַׁיָּא. Item fœminine אוּשְׁתָא, אִשִּׁין.
אוּשַׁר Ch. Idem quod אֶפְשָׁר Possibile est. Sic occurrit nonnunquam scriptum in Targ. Jonathæ.
אוֹת אוּתְיָא Ch. Monedula: vel Vespertilio. Nomen est avis immundæ, respondens Hebraeo תִּנְשֶׁמֶת, Levit.11.18. Jon.
אוּזָא Ch. Succendit, Accendit, Incendit, Dan.3.22.&19.
אוֹזְבָא Ch. Hyssopus, Psal.51.9. Syri ablato א, & ב mutato in פ dicunt זוֹפָא.
אוּזָב אוּזְנָא, אוּזַר Ch. & Syr. Legatus, Nuncius. Plur. אוּזְגִרִין.

page.notes: Syriac and Hebrew forms are transcribed from a small, faded scan; several vowel points and Syriac letters are uncertain and may differ in detail. The Greek words (ὠνησις, Εὐαγγέλιον, Εὐροκλύδων, Ἀήρ) are read as printed. Entries are set as separate paragraphs, one per headword.
